Play a commercial straight from its row in Traffic.

• Each commercial row now has a play/stop button alongside Edit and Delete. It plays through your monitor output, never the program output, on a separate audio engine from the decks — auditioning a spot can't reach air.
• A spot with no audio linked shows the button disabled rather than offering a play that would do nothing, and leaving the Commercials list stops any preview.

Includes v0.5.85: Edit and Delete on every commercial row, and :90 / :120 nominal lengths.
